verdict.rationale: Datalab is a document-parsing and extraction platform, and its AI features are mainly extraction tools rather than an insights layer. The closest matches are an endpoint that generates potential extraction schemas for a file (an AI-generated suggestion) and the ability to run published agent processors on documents. Field extraction with citations exists but returns data rather than insights. missing for 10: in-product AI-generated insights or analysis of the user's data, evidence that schema suggestions or agents surface in the Forge UI, documentation of what the agent processors produce, independent or hands-on corroboration.
